title: Correct charge q
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the charge q of ball B as 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ C.

title: Correct electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the external electric field magnitude at x=0.3 m as 3.0 × 10⁴ N/C.

title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the potential difference U between x=0.4 m and x=0.6 m as 800 V.

title: Correct minimum distance s
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the minimum distance s the constant force must act as 0.065 m.

title: Uses Coulomb's Law correctly
description: Important: Student applies Coulomb's law to find the force from charge A on ball B at a given position.

title: Applies force superposition
description: Important: Student correctly uses the superposition of forces (Coulomb + external field) to find the net force from curve II.

title: Calculates work from F-x graph
description: Important: Student correctly interprets the area under the force-position curve (curve II) to calculate work done.

title: Applies work-energy theorem
description: Important: Student correctly applies the work-energy theorem to relate work done to kinetic energy changes.

title: Sign/direction error in force
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in force direction (e.g., for Coulomb repulsion or external field), leading to incorrect net force or work.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student demonstrates consistent use of SI units (meters, Coulombs, Newtons) throughout calculations.
